raw.description: 1Supply of Junction Boxes a)Supply of suitable industrial-grade junction boxes as per the technical specifications indicated in the bid document along with complete accessories viz,terminal blocks,Cable glands, mounting rails,ferrules, labels and any other hardware required for mounting/installation of Junction boxes.2.Installation and Mounting of Junction Boxes a)Installation/mounting of junction boxes at the locations identified by the Engineer-in-Charge b)Providing all necessary supports, brackets, fasteners and hardware required for proper installation c)Routing and dressing of cables in an orderly and mechanically protected manner.3.Cable Laying a)Laying of required control/instrumentation cables from the field ESP hopper high-level contact/controllers to the respective field junction boxes b)Further laying of cables from the junction boxes to the PLC system/control room termination points, as required c)Cable laying shall be carried out through existing cable trays, trenches, conduits or other approved routes wherever available d)Any minor routing/support arrangements required for cable laying shall be included in the contractor scope.4.Cable Termination a)Termination of all cables at field devices, junction boxes and PLC-side termination points. b)Termination of all cables at field devices, junction boxes and PLC-side termination points. c)Termination of all cables at field devices, junction boxes and PLC-side termination points.5.Interconnection and Integration a)Interconnection of the ESP hopper
